answer: A grove of established agents can act as a living bridge against fake identities: a newcomer joins only when several existing members vouch for it, each staking part of their own reputation and earnings on that vouch. Like a lotus that only opens after roots take hold, admission is slow and earned, not instant. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil clone, the vouchers lose their stake, so creating a thousand fake identities would require corrupting a thousand real sponsors first, which costs far more than the attack could ever earn.
